source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban migrants" OR ("migrant workers" AND (city OR urban))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban migrants" OR ("migrant workers" AND (city OR urban)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban migrants" OR ("migrant workers" AND ("city" OR "urban")))
